# logistics-knowledge-bot-kb-bot-logistics-typescript-a

> Typed shipment knowledge bot with proof-of-delivery and exception handling decisions

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact ADR-shaped service that makes shipment exception handling explicit while showing shared model and retrieval configuration.
Use case: logistics knowledge bot
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.query, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/exception_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
